dialogue.text: I used to collect pins like you.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Then I was banned for a bit due to
"abnormal luck".
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
I guess SOMEBODY didn't like me getting
both Mythic's so quickly.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
I was surprised to get a pin from her just
for annoying her.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Did go a bit far though,<d=0.5/> she hiked up prices
after a bit...
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: I wouldn't recommend trying that yourself.
dialogue.speaker: April
